up: Retrieve all activity records for assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4649949'. Filter to only include exact measurements, i.e., where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. For each such record, output the canonical SMILES of the compound, the molecule's ChEMBL ID, the standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. No ordering or row limit is required.
sql:
SELECT cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.standard_relation,
       a.standard_value,
       a.standard_units
FROM activities a
INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649949'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
